want: the web app to read the same categories and subcategories as the Android app and let me add and remove them
soThat: a category I add on one device shows up on the other, and the web app is not limited to a fixed hardcoded list
acceptance: the web app loads the categories and subcategories tables from Supabase on startup and builds its expense category and subcategory lists from them
when the categories tables cannot be read or are empty, the web app falls back to the shipped default categories and subcategories
a Manage Categories view lists every category with its subcategories
the user can add a custom category, and a default (seeded) category cannot be deleted
the user can add and delete subcategories under any category
the category and subcategory pickers in Add Transaction, Edit Transaction, and the Transactions filters reflect the current lists
